name: Canada
registration_steps: Check if you're already registered at elections.ca (most Canadians are auto-registered)
Register online at elections.ca using your Social Insurance Number
Or register by mail using the Registration Form (Elections Canada website)
Or register in person at your local Elections Canada office
You can also register on election day at your polling station
Verify your registration and address before election day
voting_steps: Find your polling station on your Voter Information Card or at elections.ca
Bring your Voter Information Card AND one piece of ID showing name and address
Or bring two pieces of ID (one showing name and address)
Go to your polling station (usually 9:30am - 9:30pm local time)
Give your Voter Information Card and ID to election officials
Go to a voting screen and mark an X next to your candidate
Fold the ballot and return it to the DRO to be placed in the ballot box
voting_hours: 9:30 AM to 9:30 PM (local time, varies by time zone)
notes: Canadian citizens living abroad who have been away less than 5 consecutive years can vote by special ballot. Elections Canada has a VIC (Voter Information Card) mailed to registered voters.
